projectionRules.identityRule: The global Organization and Person @id and url values are invariant across every site.
projectionRules.ownedSitePublisherRule: A verified owned editorial site may identify the global TimPaemi Organization as its WebSite publisher. Client sites and unverified projects may not.
projectionRules.personUrlRule: Each global Person keeps the canonical TimPaemi profile URL. A spoke must not replace Person.url with a local profile URL.
projectionRules.profilePageRule: A verified spoke-local profile may use a local ProfilePage URL and point mainEntity to the matching global Person @id.
projectionRules.policyRule: The global TimPaemi Organization keeps all four flagship policy URLs. A local WebSite may use only its local publishingPrinciples URL. Keep local corrections, feedback, and ownership pages visible, but do not attach those Organization-only properties to WebSite.
projectionRules.siteCreatorRule: WebSite.creator may reference Tim or Paemi only when project-level creation evidence exists. Ownership or publisher status alone is not creator evidence.
projectionRules.articleAuthorRule: Article.author, author metadata, visible bylines, and rel=author require route-specific responsibility evidence and must agree. Publication-level creation is not Article authorship.
projectionRules.compactnessRule: Use full flagship entity nodes on the flagship. A spoke emits only the minimum truthful nodes needed for the visible page and must not repeat irrelevant global Person nodes on unrelated pages.
projectionRules.sameAsRule: The four approved social URLs are flagship Organization identity data. They do not authorize visible sitewide social promotion on spokes.
projectionRules.copyRule: Each repository copies and pins this versioned contract and implements a repository-local gate. No site imports a sibling repository at build time or runtime.
projectionRules.linkRule: Schema identity never creates, follows, qualifies, or requires an HTML link. HTML linking is governed separately by the network standard.
